verdict.rationale: cfo.ai exposes a programmatic surface, an MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Absent any evidence for this applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
